title: SafeStoryBrief
description: Privacy-filtered, story-safe facts derived from the user's expression. It must not contain raw input, full follow-up dialogue, identifying details, or internal story-template routing.

safetyStatus.description: A SafeStoryBrief may only be created for the story_safe workflow state.

sessionNeed.description: The user-selected need for this session, or null when the user skips it. It may affect only the tone of the epigraph and the short response after the book is closed; it must not participate in volume matching, alter the seven-chapter plot, or enter any persistent personality profile.

situationCategory.description: A neutral situation description, not a diagnosis and not the internal label/echo route.

repeatedResponse.description: A safely abstracted recurring response. Null when the user did not provide enough information.

fearedMeaning.description: What the user fears the situation may mean, only when supported by their expression.

desiredDirection.description: The direction the user hopes for, without inventing an outcome.

emotionalDirection.description: The safe emotional movement the story may support without claiming therapy or resolution.

storyUsableFacts.description: Abstracted facts that may be transformed into fairy-tale material; no identifying details or verbatim dialogue.

prohibitedInterpretations.description: Diagnoses, motives, real-world conclusions, or identity claims the story must not make.

userConfirmedSentence.description: A sentence preserved verbatim only after separate explicit confirmation; otherwise null.

missingStoryInformation.description: Information that remains unknown. Missing information is not permission to invent it.
